breakdown.description: With 60 vol% fibers at 230 GPa, the longitudinal modulus cannot fall below both constituent moduli.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification ignores the incorrect reported value of 2.5 GPa and correctly applies the rule of mixtures to obtain 139.2 GPa, which is physically consistent with 60 vol% fibers at 230 GPa. The erroneous claim that E_L = 2.5 GPa (which is below both constituent moduli) was not repeated.
